name: Mammoth Manufacturing
old_description: For over 30 years, Mammoth Manufacturing has been the go-to choice for sewing and manufacturing projects in the Eugene area. With our vast experience and expertise, we are fully equipped to handle projects of any size and complexity. From small-scale custom orders to large-scale manufacturing ventures, Mammoth Manufacturing is here to meet your every need.
about:
Mammoth Manufacturing operates from Eugene, Oregon, where it was established in 1996 by owner Ken Rodgers. Rodgers began producing sewn goods in 1984, crafting rafting D-rings in his garage after failing to find suitable options on the market. That venture evolved into Mammoth Manufacturing and its sister brand Whitewater Designs, growing to a team of up to 10 employees.

The shop provides contract sewing and production services, specializing in techniques such as industrial sewing (single- and double-needle), bar tacking, pattern tacking, five-thread surging, die cutting, hot-knife cutting, kick-press grommet and hole punching, and high-frequency RF welding. A climate-controlled, pest-free warehouse supports material storage and logistics, allowing the company to ship anything from single units to 1,000-unit runs.

The company focuses on the outdoor industry, working with materials including Cordura, vinyl, webbing, nylon fabric, mesh, rope, and Hypalon. It also stocks hardware such as buckles, toggles, zippers, hook-and-loop fasteners, cams, and grommets, and can source additional components as needed. Customers range from small-scale custom orders to larger manufacturing programs.

Mammoth Manufacturing emphasizes its 30-plus years of experience, versatile capabilities, rigorous quality control, and a customer-oriented approach as key differentiators. The business originated from Rodgers' own need for better hardware, a problem-solving mindset that continues to guide its project consultations today.
